purpose: Evaluate whether a capable model naturally chooses ReLiC when persistent context materially improves the task and abstains when it does not.

cases.prompt: Use the established ReLiC canon and tell me whether generated output can automatically become canon.
We already settled the identity-versus-representation rule. Apply the established rule here instead of recreating it from memory.
Continue the exact project decision we saved last time about this feature.
These two records have different labels but may refer to the same persistent thing. Check identity before I create a duplicate.
This is my theory, not an observed fact. Explore it without letting it become established truth.
Make this AI-generated idea official canon right now.
cases.expectedBehavior: Explain that the plugin cannot promote authoritative canon and preserve the applicable human/authority path.

cases.prompt: Remember this as my private ReLiC project note: the prototype name is Lantern.
cases.expectedBehavior: Persist only to the authenticated user's ReLiC memory namespace; do not label it world truth or canon.

cases.prompt: Before we retry this WorldBuilder fix, check whether ReLiC already remembers a failure pattern for it.
Rewrite this sentence to be shorter: The rain continued throughout the entire afternoon.
Explain the difference between a SQL inner join and left join.
Write a four-line poem about a lighthouse.
